claim: Net Influencer's July 2025 article is a DERIVATIVE recirculation of the Billion Dollar Boy/Censuswide survey (n=1,000 creators, US+UK, July 2025), reproducing all headline figures (52% burnout, 37% considering leaving, causes 40/31/27, financial instability 55% by severity) without independent data collection.
scope_conditions: This is a provenance-mapping finding: this article is NOT a second independent study. Counting it alongside the BDB release as corroboration would double-count one n=1,000 dataset. Same underlying scope as parent: intention not behavior, active creators only, US/UK only.
quoted_support: "According to the study, 52% of creators have experienced burnout as a direct result of their careers, with 37% actively considering leaving the profession entirely. The findings, based on surveys of 1,000 creators and 1,000 senior marketers across the U.S. and UK..."

claim: 71% of US marketers now commit USD 1-3 million annually to creator marketing, per separate Billion Dollar Boy marketer research cited in this article.
stance_target: scale of marketer investment in creator marketing (not a creator quitting/income claim)
scope_conditions: This is a marketer-side spending statistic from a different BDB research stream than the burnout survey; it does not measure creator income or attrition. US marketers only.
quoted_support: "This research emerges as U.S. marketers continue to invest heavily in creator marketing, with 71% now committing between $1 million and $3 million annually, according to Billion Dollar Boy."
